author: videogamefan25
quote: Worst game of all time. The amount of game breaking bugs and glitches is insane. The story is as boring as watching paint dry or watching grass grow. It's called gta 6, but you can't even commit grand theft auto on most vehicles until late game. The game barely functions at 30fps which is the most fps you'll get on both platforms. You would think that with having at least 13 years and billions of dollars to work on this game it would be perfect if not almost perfect, but it is a literal dumpster fire. I mean, this game has more boring chores then real life. I wanted to play this game to escape reality not play a real life simulator.  Even the critic reviwers agreed that this game is not perfect, but they got paid by rocksteady to give it a perfect score. If I could rate this game any lower I would. It is also no suprise rocksteady paid people to nominate this undeserving games for 8 game awards including game of the year and having it be convienently released two days after the game award nominees were announced and a day before the cutoff for nominees because rocksteady knew if they released this game a few days later it would have to wait until 2027 game awards and no one would nominate it for any award.
